title: ABHA Covers 93 Crore Patients. Its Doctor Registry Covers 67%, and Insurers Aren't Required to Use the Claims Exchange Yet

version_history.note: New post: ABHA Covers 93 Crore Patients. Its Doctor Registry Covers 67%, and Insurers Aren't Required to Use the Claims Exchange Yet -- compares ABHA's patient/doctor/insurer coverage against Estonia (95%+ doctor EHR use since 2008), Denmark (CPR since 1968, Shared Medication Record), UK (Summary Care Record 96%+ coverage but not a unified record until 2028) and Australia (opt-out consent model). Adds a reverse cross-link from the original ABHA post, and an apply_labels.py OVERRIDE entry fixing a false-positive 'Import Substitution' label triggered by the word 'registry'.
